item_summary: $150-200 dual-motor electric sit-stand desk frame with programmable memory presets and collision detection
detailed_item_draft: Detailed requirement specification for a dual-motor electric sit-stand desk frame priced between $150 and $200 USD. The unit must incorporate a dual-motor lifting system capable of supporting a maximum static load of at least 155 lbs with a height adjustment range from 24.5 inches to 50.5 inches. Control panel must feature a digital LED display with a minimum of 4 programmable memory preset buttons for rapid height recall. Safety mechanisms must include an integrated collision detection sensor that triggers an automatic stop and reverse sequence upon encountering resistance during movement. Operational acoustics must remain below 50dB during ascent and descent cycles. Frame width must be adjustable between 43 inches and 63 inches to accommodate various desktop dimensions. Construction material must be heavy-gauge cold-rolled steel with a corrosion-resistant powder-coated finish to ensure durability. The shipment must include all required crossbars, mounting brackets, power cords, and the control box. Manufacturer warranty must cover motors and structural frame for a minimum of 5 years.
